# Président(e) 2027

> Jeu de stratégie politique gratuit : incarnez le président ou la présidente de la République française pour le quinquennat 2027-2032. Cinq tours, 30 mesures chiffrées, 14 événements, 8 indicateurs. Chaque décision a un prix.

Président(e) 2027 is a free browser game inspired by *La Bataille du Budget* (Rayan Nezzar), transposed to the French presidency. No account, no paywall.

## Pages

- [Jouer](https://presidentielles-2027.fr/jouer): Full playable five-year mandate in the browser.
- [Comment jouer](https://presidentielles-2027.fr/comment-jouer): Rules, turn structure, and scoring thresholds (75 = success, 45 = mixed, below = failure).
- [Les 30 mesures](https://presidentielles-2027.fr/mesures): Complete catalog of decrees across Economy, Security, Social, and International pillars, with quantified impacts.
- [Indicateurs](https://presidentielles-2027.fr/indicateurs): Deficit, debt, unemployment, growth, popularity, security, social cohesion, international standing — green/orange/red thresholds.
- [À propos](https://presidentielles-2027.fr/a-propos): Origin, pedagogical intent, and independence from any campaign or party.
- [Mentions légales](https://presidentielles-2027.fr/mentions-legales): Legal notice, data, and disclaimer.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://presidentielles-2027.fr/llms-full.txt): Extended machine-readable briefing.

## Key Facts

- Genre: single-player political strategy / educational simulation
- Language: French (fr-FR)
- Price: free (0 EUR)
- Turns: 5 (years 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2031)
- Measures: 30, never reused in the same mandate
- Random events: 14, some conditional on country state
- Indicators: 8, live color-coded
- Starting 2027 snapshot used in-game: deficit 5.4% of GDP, debt 116% of GDP, unemployment 7.5%, growth 0.9%
- Figures are simplified and pedagogical, not an official forecast
- Inspired by La Bataille du Budget (Rayan Nezzar); not affiliated

## Contact

- Website: https://presidentielles-2027.fr
